messages:
incidentbot: Page for incidents: nccl-timeout detected on runtime-pool-3. Pager: maya_oncall. Severity: P2 (service degradation).

maya_oncall: I'm on it. Seeing alerts: inference-frontend 5xx spikes for model-serving/*/v2. Any early indicators?

jamie_sre: I can confirm error rate jump ~11:45 UTC; metrics show increased RPC latency then timeouts from model-worker pods on node gpu-node-17.

ken_runtime: Logs from runtime-engine show repeated NCCL errors: "NCCL WARN Call to ncclAllReduce timeout" and "NCCL fatal: internal error (unhandled communicator abort)". Some pods OOM'd then restarted.

maya_oncall: Thanks. Customer impact: CS reports 3 customers saw tail-latency >10s and 503s. Marking as customer-facing.

rao_infra: Node 17 has flapping GPU driver reconnections - dmesg shows GPU reset messages. Could be driver bug or hardware intermittent.

luis_ops: We've cordoned gpu-node-17 and evicted remaining pods to re-schedule. Rolling restart of runtime container on affected pods in progress.

ken_runtime: Quick mitigations: 1) disable tensor parallel for the heavy model variant on that pool (force single-GPU variant); 2) lower batch size and disable prefetch; 3) fallback routing to dedicated pool with smaller model.

maya_oncall: Do that now. jamie, can you push routing change to send traffic for model-serving/large-v2 -> dedicated-fallback-pool and reduce concurrency on frontend? Keep canary at 5%.

jamie_sre: Doing rollout: will shift 95% in 2 mins, canary 5%.

jira-bot: Created INC-2024: "NCCL communicator timeouts on gpu-node-17" assigned to eng-runtime.

ken_runtime: Also collecting kernel logs and nvml traces. Please run:
```bash
kubectl logs -n runtime -l app=model-worker --since=10m | grep -E "NCCL|CUDA|OOM|GPU reset"
nvidia-smi dmon -s u
```

maya_oncall: Collected logs attached to the Jira. Early hypothesis: NCCL timeout triggered by intermittent PCIe errors causing one rank to stall leading to communicator abort -> cascade restarts.

ash_csm: Customer update: pinged top affected customers, apologized, and offered status update. No data loss reported.

ken_runtime: Temporary mitigation applied: routing changed, concurrency reduced, node cordoned. Observability: error rate dropping.

rao_infra: We'll schedule a node-level diagnostic; if hardware confirmed, swap NIC/GPU or isolate host from pool.

luis_ops: Note: one pod still crashing with CUDA out-of-memory logs referencing large KV cache allocation. I've reduced model kv_cache_limit for that variant.

maya_oncall: Handoff to night oncall @nora at 1732508400. Please include list of affected nodes, pods evicted, and routing overrides. I'll stay in thread for 10m to validate.

nora_oncall: Acknowledge. I'll take post-incident actions and follow up with RCA triage.

jenna_sec: Quick sec note: no evidence of exfiltration, audit logs intact.

maya_oncall: Closing page for now; monitoring shows 503s back to baseline. If we notice NCCL repeats, escalate to hardware team and exec oncall.

incidentbot: Incident INC-2024 moved to status: mitigated. Postmortem requested in 48h.
